title: Integrability and sup-norm bound for the pairing integral ∫_E ξ(ω) dμ of a form vanishing off a finite-measure set
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let μ be a measure on ℝ^P (Euclid P), and let ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_n(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P n: continuous linear functionals on n-covectors) be μ-a.e. strongly measurable and such that, for μ-a.e. x, |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| holds for every n-covector α, where |α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α is the Euclidean coefficient norm. Let E, K ⊆ ℝ^P with K measurable and μ(K) < ∞, let ω : ℝ^P → Λⁿ(ℝ^P) (DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) be continuous with ω(x) = 0 for every x ∉ K, and let ε ∈ ℝ satisfy |ω(x)| ≤ ε for every x ∈ ℝ^P. Then x ↦ ξ(x)(ω(x)) is integrable with respect to μ restricted to E, and |∫_E ξ(x)(ω(x)) dμ(x)| ≤ ε·μ(K), where μ(K) is read as the real number (μ K).toReal.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n) (E K : Set (Euclid P)) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (ε : ℝ), AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → Continuous ω → MeasurableSet K → μ K < ∞ → (∀ x, x ∉ K → ω x = 0) → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (ω x) ≤ ε) → Integrable (fun x => ξ x (ω x)) (μ.restrict E) ∧ |∫ x in E, ξ x (ω x) ∂μ| ≤ ε * (μ K).toReal
